description: Reads project files you pass in (contents, not paths on disk) and reports every runtime and framework it detects (Node.js, .NET and .NET Framework, ASP.NET Core, AngularJS, Angular, React, Next.js, Vue, Python, Django, PostgreSQL, MySQL and more) with its support status, sorted most urgent first, plus a one-paragraph summary. Supported files: package.json, package-lock.json, npm-shrinkwrap.json, angular.json, bower.json, *.csproj / *.vbproj / *.fsproj, Directory.Build.props, global.json, web.config, packages.config, requirements*.txt, pyproject.toml, Pipfile, .python-version, runtime.txt, .nvmrc, .node-version, .tool-versions, Dockerfile / *.dockerfile / Containerfile, docker-compose*.yml / compose*.yaml.

date.description: Date to evaluate support on, as YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today. Use it for "will this still be supported on ...?" questions.

content.description: Full text content of the file.

path.description: File name or path, for example "package.json" or "src/Web/Web.csproj". The name decides how it is read.

name: scan_project
title: Scan project files
